gatoh.graphs.graphs.Graph

class Graph(name: str, rw_params: tuple[float, float], generation_method: str = '', suppress_warnings: bool = False, dynamic_rels: bool = True)[source]

A graph class that defines a single agent-based model layer.

This corresponds to the agents’ attitudes towards one another with respect to different social hierarchies.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – The name of the social hierarchy that this Graph object will be representing.

  • rw_params (tuple[float, float]) – The (mean, variance) of the normal distribution used for the dynamic relationships random walk.

  • generation_method (str, optional) – The random graph generation method that should be used where relevant.

  • suppress_warnings (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if non-critical warnings should be suppressed.

  • dynamic_rels (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if dynamic relationships should be modelled for this social hierarchy.
